name: Vocus ASC (Australia Singapore Cable) landing station, Flying Fish Cove
notes: sub_location Flying Fish Cove / Settlement. ASC in service September 2018, 4,600 km Perth-Singapore via Christmas Island and Indonesia, capacity up to 60 Tbps (Vocus official page verified 2026-08-12). DITRDCA IOT bulletin 2018 (methodology-verified) places the cable landing station beside the Flying Fish Cove Administration building. COUNTED AS TELECOM/CABLE LANDING INFRASTRUCTURE - not commercial colocation (no rack/hosting/colo product confirmed for the island per CX methodology).

name: CiFi local fibre ISP / fixed wireless / 4G LTE network
developer: CiFi Pty Ltd (Christmas Island Fibre Internet)
notes: sub_location Settlement / Drumsite (offices incl. 45 Gaze Road per directory). CiFi states it is Christmas Island's first and only fibre internet service provider, network exclusively supported by the Vocus ASC, offering home/business and 4G mobile plans (official site verified 2026-08-12; DITRDCA 2024 Service Delivery kit lists CiFi as local internet distributor). COUNTED AS NETWORK OPERATOR LEAD - not colocation per CX methodology.

name: Telstra 4G/4GX mobile service
notes: sub_location island-wide mobile coverage. Parks Australia official page (verified 2026-08-12): 'A Telstra 4G GSM Mobile Telephone Service operates on the Island.' ARN (2022): Vocus + Telstra used ASC backhaul to upgrade Christmas Island mobile from 2G to 4GX. COUNTED AS MOBILE TELECOM INFRASTRUCTURE - not a data centre.

name: Google Bosun + interlink subsea cables (Australia Connect)
developer: Google (Global Network Infrastructure), with Vocus/NEXTDC/SUBCO partners
notes: sub_location Flying Fish Cove (direct beach landing at both Flying Fish Cove sites per EPBC referral 2025/10313 'Subsea Fibre Optic Data Cable Systems Installation - Australia West'). Google official (2024-11-26): Bosun cable connects Darwin to Christmas Island with onward connectivity to Singapore; interlink cable connects Melbourne, Perth and Christmas Island. EPBC referral (status: Referral Decision Made) covers cable systems/landings at Madora Bay WA, Flying Fish Cove CX, Darwin NT; cable installation scheduled from Feb 2026 (10-12 months). COUNTED AS PLANNED CABLE/LANDING PROJECT - connectivity infrastructure, not a data centre approval.

name: Google Dhivaru subsea cable + Christmas Island connectivity hub
notes: sub_location Christmas Island (hub location TBD; connectivity-hub concept). Google official (2025-11-17): Dhivaru is a new Trans-Indian Ocean cable connecting the Maldives, Christmas Island and Oman; Google will invest in two regional connectivity hubs (Maldives, Christmas Island) with capabilities of cable switching, content caching and COLOCATION - rack space for carriers/local companies, explicitly 'far less power than a typical data center'. COUNTED AS PLANNED SUBSEA CABLE CONNECTIVITY + connectivity-hub project; NOT a confirmed large data centre.

name: Google AI data centre / data hub (reported lead)
notes: sub_location Airport / XCH area (reported 'advanced talks to lease land near the island's airport'). Reuters 2025-11-06 (via Jakarta Post/Independent/Submarine Networks): Google plans a large AI data centre on Christmas Island after a cloud deal with the Department of Defence; source quoted requesting a long-term energy deal for a ~7 MW facility using diesel + renewable power; island's biggest employer (Christmas Island Phosphates/PRL-CIP) said power can support it without depriving locals. UNCONFIRMED LEAD: Google has not issued a facility announcement; no Shire development approval, EPBC non-cable referral, AusTender or power-connection primary document found as of 2026-08-12; capacity 7 MW is reported, not primary. Keep B/C until primary approval/announcement.

name: Commercial colocation / cloud region (verified negative)
notes: Verified negative as of 2026-08-12: no AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI Christmas Island cloud region or local zone (official region pages show no CX; Australian mainland regions do not cover island-local facilities); no public commercial colocation, carrier hotel or rack-space product on Christmas Island; directory entries (datacentermap/datacenters/cloudscene) absent or C-grade without address/operator. Overall CX conclusion: no confirmed commercial datacenter; confirmed telecom/cable infrastructure; monitor Google data-centre lead.
